import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final long[] powers = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000};
    
    static int global_counter = 0;
    static int final_answer = 0;
    static long N;
    static long[] sums = new long[7];
    static int[] counts = new int[7];
    static List<Integer>[] data = new List[7];
    
    static class FastReader {
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 21];
        private int ptr = 0;
        private int len = 0;
        
        private int getc() throws IOException {
            if (ptr == len) {
                len = System.in.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len == -1) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++] & 0xFF;
        }
        
        private int readInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = getc()) <= 32 && c != -1) {}
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            
            boolean neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                c = getc();
            }
            
            int x = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = getc();
            }
            return neg ? -x : x;
        }
        
        private long readLong() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = getc()) <= 32 && c != -1) {}
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            
            boolean neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                neg = true;
                c = getc();
            }
            
            long x = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = getc();
            }
            return neg ? -x : x;
        }
    }
    
    static class FastWriter {
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 21];
        private int ptr = 0;
        
        private void flush() throws IOException {
            System.out.write(buffer, 0, ptr);
            ptr = 0;
        }
        
        private void putc(int c) throws IOException {
            buffer[ptr++] = (byte) c;
            if (ptr >= buffer.length) flush();
        }
        
        private void write(int x, char sep) throws IOException {
            if (x < 0) { putc('-'); x = -x; }
            if (x == 0) { putc('0'); if (sep != -1) putc(sep); return; }
            char[] tmp = new char[20];
            int len = 0;
            while (x > 0) { tmp[len++] = (char)('0' + x % 10); x /= 10; }
            while (len-- > 0) putc(tmp[len]);
            if (sep != -1) putc(sep);
        }
        
        private void write(long x, char sep) throws IOException {
            if (x < 0) { putc('-'); x = -x; }
            if (x == 0) { putc('0'); if (sep != -1) putc(sep); return; }
            char[] tmp = new char[20];
            int len = 0;
            while (x > 0) { tmp[len++] = (char)('0' + x % 10); x /= 10; }
            while (len-- > 0) putc(tmp[len]);
            if (sep != -1) putc(sep);
        }
        
        private void write(String s) throws IOException {
            for (char c : s.toCharArray()) putc(c);
        }
        
        private void close() throws IOException {
            flush();
        }
    }
    
    static void build_data(int cur, int depth) {
        int val = (global_counter - cur + MOD) % MOD;
        data[depth].add(val);
        sums[depth] = (sums[depth] + val) % MOD;
        counts[depth]++;
        global_counter++;
        
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            build_data(cur * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }
    
    static void solve_query(int base, long pos) {
        for (int d = 0; d < 7; ++d) {
            long target = (pos - 1L * base * powers[d]) % MOD;
            if (target < 0) target += MOD;
            
            List<Integer> list = data[d];
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, (int)(MOD - target));
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
            int cnt = list.size() - idx;
            
            long part1 = sums[d];
            long part2 = (target * counts[d]) % MOD;
            long part3 = (cnt * (long)MOD) % MOD;
            
            final_answer = (final_answer + (int)(part1 + part2 - part3)) % MOD2;
            if (final_answer < 0) final_answer += MOD2;
        }
    }
    
    static void dfs(long cur) {
        if ((cur + 1) * powers[6] <= N + 1 && cur * powers[7] > N) {
            solve_query((int)cur, global_counter + 1);
            global_counter += global_counter;
            return;
        }
        
        global_counter++;
        int diff = ((global_counter - cur) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        final_answer = (final_answer + diff) % MOD2;
        if (final_answer < 0) final_answer += MOD2;
        
        int startD = (cur == 0 ? 1 : 0);
        for (int d = startD; d < 10; ++d) {
            long next_val = cur * 10 + d;
            if (next_val <= N) {
                dfs(next_val);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
            data[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        FastReader reader = new FastReader();
        FastWriter writer = new FastWriter();
        
        build_data(0, 0);
        N = reader.readLong();
        dfs(0);
        writer.write(final_answer, '\n');
        writer.close();
    }
}
